Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the logs Sophie attached — this looks like a token rotation edge case with our SCIM adapter. Short summary:

- Root cause: intermittent 401s caused by overlapping token refresh requests when the Okta push includes large user batches.
- Impact: user push partially succeeds, then fails on the next batch which leaves users in limbo.
- Fix: patch the SCIM adapter to serialize refresh calls and retry transient 401s (small code change + config).

Estimate & recommendation: 3 business days of engineering work (SE + infra runbook) to fully stabilize in the sandbox. Given that timeline I recommend we grant 2 weeks of additional trial time and provision 5,000 additional sandbox credits now so the customer can continue testing without immediate throttling. If the patch uncovers more load issues we'll revisit and top-up credits.

I've attached a quick troubleshooting note and the command logs I ran while repro-ing (internal notes — not customer-facing). I'll be available for a 30-min debug session with Tom tomorrow morning if they can share access.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
